title: Asahina Mafuyu — A Stillness Only You Know〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Raise Your Bow in a Snow-White World

rows.Line: Holiday
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Cram school ended much sooner than usual today since we had a short class...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But they gave us more assignments than usual, so I'll need to get started on those as soon as I can...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And Mom's going to be home all day, so I probably won't be able to work on anything N25-related...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(...
For now, I should get home as soon as I can...)
Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so nice to run into you outside of school like this. Were you about to go somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I was on my way home from cram school. What about you, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have practice today as MORE MORE JUMP!, but I wanted to do some shopping first.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember how we ended up walking to the station together after I broke my umbrella?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, right... It did get bent pretty badly...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it did. So, I'm here to buy a new one at this shop Airi showed me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see.
I hope you find a nice replacement.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
But I hope I can find this shop before practice...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do you not know where it is...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So... Airi showed me the website for it, which listed its location... Unfortunately, I ended up getting lost...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I know what to do now! It's supposed to be right by the post office, so I just need to keep an eye out for that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hang on... What if you end up finding the wrong post office?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Y-You're right...!
I would've gotten even more lost if I did! Thank you, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Y-You're welcome...
Also, mind if I take a look at the shop on a map?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
A map? Sure, here you go.
It's the one from the website...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you. Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're looking for the shop on Miyamasuzaka, right, Hinomori? This appears to be a map for a different branch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?! But Airi said it's right by the post office...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's one very close to the Miyamasuzaka branch. This is where we are right now, and the post office I think you're looking for is here. Which means the shop you wish to visit is this one.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I-It was under my nose this entire time?! Oh no... I feel so embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, don't be. You managed to get this close by yourself. Also, you probably would've found it just fine if it weren't for this map.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A-Asahina...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know. Hinomori, mind if I take a look inside with you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Cram school ended early for me today, so I have some time on my hands.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So... It's this way, yes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
Now, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for helping me pick this out, Asahina! As a result, I was able to find a wonderful replacement umbrella.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I promise to cherish it for as long as I can.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that. Especially after we put quite a lot of thought into selecting it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, also, it's bigger than what you normally see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I wanted one that I could share with others.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: With this, I'll be able to help Shii, Airi or anyone else who forgets to bring their umbrella.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That of course also includes you, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Remember how you helped me the other day?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to return the favor the next chance I get.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you, Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to get to practice. Thank you for joining me today, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Anytime. It was my pleasure.
See you again at school.
